sourceOfTruth: GOVERNANCE DOCUMENTS/PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE AND WORKFLOW SPECIFICATION.md, Part Nine, and OPERATIONAL MANUALS/PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE AND BUILD ROADMAP.md, Part 5 — this manifest is a status board over that governance, never the other way around
updateInstructions: Edit only the "status" (and optionally "note") field on a task when real work happens. Valid statuses: not-started, in-progress, complete, blocked. Do not add, remove, or reorder tasks without checking them against the governing documents first. The server re-reads this file on every request, so a saved edit shows up the next time the dashboard polls, no restart needed.

openBlockers.label: The dgenie_app Postgres role password passed through a Claude Code chat transcript.
openBlockers.detail: Not committed to git (confirmed by direct search of the full commit history) and nothing is deployed publicly yet, so this is a hygiene issue, not an active breach — but the password should be rotated via Supabase before Phase 1 or any deployment relies on it, since a chat transcript is not a secrets store.

openBlockers.detail: Recommended candidate is Stripe, matching the pre-reset build's own archived design, but not confirmed.

openBlockers.label: The 10%-scholarship-pool reading is unconfirmed.
openBlockers.detail: Read as implementing the existing constitutional 10%-of-net-revenue floor via a per-transaction earmark, not a separate obligation — flagged for Duncan twice, still not confirmed.

openBlockers.detail: Blueprint 11 itself names this as open, since Home Track and Membership Track cadences plausibly cost different amounts of Mentor time.

openBlockers.detail: Become live decisions the moment Phase 1 work actually starts.
